description: Traffic Cameras is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This dataset contains information about traffic cameras in Austin, TX. These cameras are used to monitor real-time LIVE traffic conditions only. Video is NOT recorded or retained of daily traffic. Traffic cameras are owned and operated by Austin Transportation & Public Works. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are traffic, mobility, cameras, transportation. The table has 32 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
